Catalogues lead.paragraph: Browse full ranges, dimensions and specifications. Need pricing? Send us your selection and we will prepare a tailored quote.

style.Catalogues head: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 40px; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 20px; }
style.Catalogues head left: flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; padding: 0px; width: 700px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start;
style.Catalogue list: padding: 0px; gap: 16px; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto; @media(--tablet){ grid-template-columns: repeat(1, 1fr); gap: 16px; } @media(--mobile){ grid-template-columns: repeat(1, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
style.Catalogue 1: background: #FFFFFF; min-height: 110px; padding: 20px 24px 20px 20px; gap: 22px; align-items: center; @media(--mobile){ padding: 16px; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
style.Catalogue 1 badge: width: 56px; min-width: 56px; height: 64px; padding: 0px; background: var(--on-navy); justify-content: center; align-items: center;
style.Catalogue 1 pdf: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
style.Catalogue 1 info: flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 0px; flex-grow: 1; flex-basis: 0px; align-items: stretch; @media(--mobile){ flex-basis: 160px; }
style.Catalogue 1 title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 24px; line-height: 28px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: var(--on-navy); @media(--mobile){ font-size: 21px; line-height: 25px; }
style.Catalogue 1 meta: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: var(--on-muted);
style.Catalogue 1 download: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.8px; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--on-navy); background: transparent; border: 1px solid #0B2F62; border-radius: 0px; padding: 12px 18px; transition: background-color 0.3s; &:hover{ background: #0B2F62; color: #FFFFFF; } @media(--mobile){ margin-left: 70px; }

style.Catalogue 13 pdf: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
style.Catalogue 13 info: flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 0px; flex-grow: 1; flex-basis: 0px; align-items: stretch; @media(--mobile){ flex-basis: 160px; }
